title: Statistical Learning Theory
standfirst: The mathematical theory of generalisation — VC dimension, PAC learning, and modern extensions.

description_paragraphs: This course introduces statistical learning theory, including models such as the PAC framework. It covers classical concepts like Vapnik's uniform convergence and modern ideas such as algorithmic stability, along with an introduction to unsupervised learning theory and a high-level overview of modern deep learning theory.
